description: Summary figure and decision table: Gtt3 domain architecture, beta-strand content, Foldseek and sequence-similarity evidence
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, itertools
plt.rcParams.update({'font.size':9,'axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False})
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,9.2))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.15,1.0,1.0],hspace=0.62,wspace=0.26)

# ---- A: domain architecture ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
tracks=[
 ("Gtt3 (P39996, 337 aa)",337,[(12,46,'HeH / SAP-like (2 helices)','#4C78A8'),(75,160,'disordered','#BAB0AC'),
                               (162,239,'helical, cytoplasmic','#9ECAE9'),(240,260,'TM1','#F58518'),(314,336,'TM2','#F58518')]),
 ("Gtt1 (P40582, 234 aa)",234,[(2,85,'GST_N (thioredoxin fold)','#54A24B'),(90,225,'GST_C (all-helical)','#88D27A')]),
 ("Gtt2 (Q12390, 233 aa)",233,[(2,85,'GST_N_2','#54A24B'),(90,225,'GST_C','#88D27A')]),
 ("hGSTP1 (P09211, 210 aa)",210,[(3,78,'GST_N','#54A24B'),(82,200,'GST_C_3','#88D27A')]),
]
for k,(name,L,blocks) in enumerate(tracks):
    y=len(tracks)-k
    ax.plot([0,L],[y,y],color='#DDD',lw=7,solid_capstyle='butt',zorder=1)
    for a,b,lab,c in blocks:
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((a,y-0.19),b-a,0.38,color=c,zorder=2))
        if b-a>35: ax.text((a+b)/2,y,lab,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7.2,color='w',zorder=3)
    ax.text(-8,y,name,ha='right',va='center',fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlim(-120,430); ax.set_ylim(0.4,4.7); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel('residue')
ax.set_title('A. Domain architecture (Pfam/InterPro). Gtt3 carries no GST_N or GST_C domain,\n    only the Gtt3-specific families PF27945 and PF30540', loc='left', fontsize=9.5)

# ---- B: beta-strand content ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
d=pd.read_csv('out/ss_summary.csv')
order=['GTT3 P39996','GTT1 P40582','GTT2 Q12390','GTO2(GSTO3) Q04806','URE2 P23202','GSTP1_HUMAN P09211','GRX1 P25373']
d=d.set_index('protein').loc[order].reset_index()
cols=['#E45756']+['#54A24B']*6
ax.barh(range(len(d)),d.pct_strand,color=cols)
for i,(s,n) in enumerate(zip(d.pct_strand,d.n_strands)):
    ax.text(s+0.3,i,f'{s:.1f}%  ({n} strands)',va='center',fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(d))); ax.set_yticklabels([p.split()[0] for p in d.protein],fontsize=8)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlim(0,24); ax.set_xlabel('beta-strand content of AlphaFold model (%)')
ax.set_title('B. Thioredoxin-fold beta sheet\n    (Kabsch-Sander on AlphaFold models)',loc='left',fontsize=9.5)

# ---- C: Foldseek vs PDB100 ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
labels=['Gtt3 full\n(1-337)','Gtt3 cytoplasmic\n(1-239)','Gtt3 core\n(130-245)','Gtt1\n(positive ctrl)','Gtt2\n(positive ctrl)']
nhits=[0,0,0,344,451]   # hits with 'glutathione/GST' in PDB title
tot=[6,0,0,437,578]
x=np.arange(len(labels))
ax.bar(x-0.19,tot,0.38,label='all PDB100 hits returned',color='#B0B0B0')
ax.bar(x+0.19,nhits,0.38,label="hits titled glutathione/GST",color='#54A24B')
for i,(t,g) in enumerate(zip(tot,nhits)):
    ax.text(i-0.19,t+12,str(t),ha='center',fontsize=7.5); ax.text(i+0.19,g+12,str(g),ha='center',fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.5); ax.set_ylabel('number of Foldseek hits')
ax.set_ylim(0,660); ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,frameon=False)
ax.set_title('C. Foldseek (3Di-AA) against PDB100.\n    Gtt3 best hit prob=0.13, E=4.0 (no significant match)',loc='left',fontsize=9.5)

# ---- D: Smith-Waterman Z ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
sw=pd.read_csv('out/sw_scores.csv')
sw['pair']=sw['query']+' vs '+sw['target']
sw=sw.sort_values('Z')
c=['#E45756' if q=='Gtt3' else '#54A24B' for q in sw['query']]
ax.barh(range(len(sw)),sw.Z,color=c)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sw))); ax.set_yticklabels(sw.pair,fontsize=7.5)
ax.axvline(3,ls='--',color='k',lw=0.8); ax.text(3.15,0.2,'Z = 3',fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel('Smith-Waterman Z score vs shuffled null (20 shuffles)')
ax.set_title('D. Sequence similarity. Red = Gtt3 queries,\n    green = GST vs GST controls',loc='left',fontsize=9.5)

# ---- E: pLDDT ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1])
pl=np.load('out/plddt.npy')
ax.plot(np.arange(1,len(pl)+1),pl,color='#4C78A8',lw=1.1)
ax.axhspan(0,50,color='#F2C0BE',alpha=.35); ax.axhspan(50,70,color='#FDE3A7',alpha=.4)
for a,b,lab,c in [(12,46,'HeH/SAP','#4C78A8'),(240,260,'TM1','#F58518'),(314,336,'TM2','#F58518')]:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=.18); ax.text((a+b)/2,101,lab,ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel('residue'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_ylim(20,108); ax.set_xlim(1,337)
ax.set_title('E. AlphaFold confidence, AF-P39996-F1 (mean 78.5)',loc='left',fontsize=9.5)

fig.suptitle('Gtt3 (P39996) is not a glutathione S-transferase: no GST domain, no thioredoxin fold, no GST structural or sequence relatives',
             fontsize=11.5,y=0.985)
plt.show()

# artifact tables
pd.DataFrame([
 dict(check='Pfam/InterPro domains', result='PF27945 GTT3_N + PF30540 GTT3_C; no PF02798/PF13409 GST_N, no PF00043/PF13410 GST_C', verdict='no GST domain'),
 dict(check='beta-strand content of AF model', result='0 strands / 337 res (53.7% helix); Gtt1 4 strands, Gtt2 6, GSTP1 4, Ure2 4, Grx1 4', verdict='no thioredoxin fold'),
 dict(check='Foldseek full-length vs PDB100', result='0 significant hits (best prob 0.126, E=4.03)', verdict='no GST structural relative'),
 dict(check='Foldseek 1-239 and 130-245 vs PDB100', result='0 hits returned', verdict='no cryptic GST domain'),
 dict(check='Foldseek positive control Gtt1/Gtt2 vs PDB100', result='437/578 hits, 344/451 titled glutathione or GST, prob=1.0, E 1e-9 to 1e-31', verdict='method detects GST folds'),
 dict(check='Foldseek 1-239 vs AFDB-SwissProt', result='self only', verdict='no GST relative'),
 dict(check='Foldseek 1-60 vs PDB100/AFDB-SwissProt', result='SAP domains of nucleolar protein and splicing factor, Rho N-terminal domain, SIZ1, PARP2', verdict='HeH/SAP-like, DNA/nucleic-acid-binding-type module'),
 dict(check='Smith-Waterman vs GSTs', result='Gtt3 vs Gtt1 Z=0.68, vs Gtt2 Z=-0.92, vs Gto2 Z=0.28, vs Ure2 Z=-0.07, vs hGSTP1 Z=-1.00; control Gtt2 vs hGSTP1 Z=11.3', verdict='no sequence homology'),
 dict(check='catalytic G-site residue (Tyr/Ser/Cys at N-term of alpha1 after beta1)', result='no beta1, no alpha1 equivalent; position does not exist', verdict='G-site absent, not degenerate'),
 dict(check='topology', result='2 TM helices (240-260, 314-336), nuclear membrane, cytoplasmic N-terminus', verdict='incompatible with soluble dimeric cytosolic GST'),
]).to_csv('out/gtt3_decision_table.csv',index=False)
print(open('out/gtt3_decision_table.csv').read())
